title: Feed-health / pipeline status
description: Per-feed health, written by scripts/pipeline_status.py with loud assertions. The silent-scraper-404 lesson: every feed asserts row-count and staleness and fails loudly instead of masking a 0-row write.

generated_utc.description: ISO-8601 UTC timestamp this status was written.

feeds.description: Map of feed name -> its health record.

rows.description: Row count of the last write; 0 must never be silently ok.

last_success_utc.description: Timestamp of last successful non-empty write, or null if never.

note.description: Optional human-readable WHY for a status that would otherwise read as silence: a legitimately-zero feed (e.g. 0 regular-season finals before kickoff, preseason excluded by design) or a degraded market source's own reason. Absent when there is nothing to explain.

schedules.description: Cron cadence of every scheduled workflow, PARSED FROM .github/workflows/*.yml by scripts/pipeline_status.read_schedules(). Shipped so the MODEL tab's 'how often does this run' claim is read from the real cron and cannot drift from the YAML. Optional: absent on older writes.
